candidates.review_note: Process tasks by descending power. Every second-round task must consume an unmatched strictly higher-power first task, so equal-power groups are processed together. For a fixed integer threshold the objective is sum(1000*a-threshold*b) over first tasks; among equal powers choose largest processor counts. DP tracks unmatched first tasks. Integer binary search returns the required ceiling without float rounding.

Sweep interval maxima to get the tightest upper bound at each position. A constraint with maximum m needs an m-valued position among exactly those whose cap is m; map it into that cap group, rejecting empty ranges. Within each group count weighted binary choices (m-1 lower values or one maximum), tracking last maximum and deleting states violating completed interval requirements. Groups multiply independently; m=1 has one assignment.

Linearity splits niceness into fixed-fixed, fixed-missing, and missing-missing pairs. Condition on one or two missing values, multiply gcd by the number of positive compositions for the remaining sum. Explicit zero-variable composition handles fully specified arrays and exactly one/two missing entries; impossible sums contribute zero. Counts missing slots as labeled positions.

Each card is one Boolean choice; both faces contribute opposite literals. Pairwise coprimality means at most one chosen face contains each prime. Sequential-counter2SAT encoding makes each prime group linear size instead of quadratic, including primes on both faces of the same card. Iterative Tarjan rejects any variable sharing SCC with its complement, and SPF removes repeated powers.

Slope-trick DP shifts convex breakpoint heaps by ±d for neighbor constraints and adds absolute-deviation cost for each internal pile. Initial height gets weight n+1, which enforces it exactly whenever endpoints are feasible: moving it can save at most n-2 unit slopes elsewhere. Evaluate final convex function at fixed last height instead of optimizing it. Integer arithmetic handles huge heights and d=0.

Enumerate unordered positive radii and integer displacement vectors whose squared length is(radius1+radius2)^2. Count lattice placements by intersecting each circle center allowed bounding intervals, multiply sign orientations, and divide by2 only when radii coincide. Exact isqrt prevents tangency rounding; boundaries of the rectangle may be touched.

Compress each node to its nearest ancestor with weight at least its own, using binary lifting to find that ancestor on insertion. Lifted block sums include the current node and jump past the block; greedy largest affordable blocks answer queries. A non-node sentinel has infinite cost so zero-weight chains terminate correctly. Decode every parameter using previous type2 answer and retain compact numeric arrays.
